span.p:
1. PR to main
touches modules, core,
tests, or versioning script

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. Checkout repo
full history for diff checks

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. Detect changed modules
from modules/** paths

span.p:
No module changes
contract validation is the main check

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7. Check module versioning
module.yml version and CHANGELOG
for release-impacting changes

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8. Run smoke tests
for changed modules when
runtime/tests/test_run_small.sh exists

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

9. PR check result
must pass before merge to main
